notes: Four named candidate slots map one-to-one to model IDs and rates below.
Rates are a versioned estimate snapshot and must be refreshed before a future live run.
The runner reserves estimated maximum input/output cost before each request and stops before the next request if the cumulative reservation would exceed its USD 0.25 cap.
The output reservation uses twice each stage max_tokens limit; phase 0 and utility perturb allow 256 tokens, style scrub 192, and both digit evaluations remain locked at 16.
The five-item, four-slot run has 100 baseline calls and at most 180 calls with four word-count repairs per item/model; every retry is separately reserved under the same USD 0.25 cap.
The USD 0.25 cap is enforced by this runner using the listed estimates; it is not an upstream provider billing limit.
